title: AI Router CC-knowledge response v1
description: Fully defined in Commit C1 for forward validation, but not yet produced by any active route or Ollama call - that wiring is Commit C2. schemaVersion is a separate counter from cc-summary (1.0), cc-status (1.0) and the core router schema (2.0). `sources` is always built server-side from the RAG search results actually included in the prompt, never parsed out of a model's free text - see orchestrator/cc-knowledge-rag-service.js.

state.description: ok: an answer was produced with at least one grounding source (context and/or knowledge). partial: an answer was produced despite one of the two grounding sources being unavailable. unavailable: no answer was produced (Ollama failure, or neither context nor knowledge available at all).

answer.description: Null only when state is 'unavailable'. Never produced in Commit C1 - no route calls Ollama yet.

sourceDoc.description: Relative FELIX_SYSTEM vault path only - never an absolute path or an internal index file path.
